description: Configure Wazuh email alert notifications. In the Wazuh dashboard, navigate to Management > Configuration. Enable email alerting by setting the email_notification option to 'yes', set the SMTP server to 'smtp.company.internal', set the email_to address to 'security-alerts@company.com', and set the email_from address to 'wazuh@company.com'. Set the email_maxperhour to 12. Save the configuration changes.
